brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Built 2-wide x 2-high column from 4x Hex base Full (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,1;full, piece:1,0,1;full) with top covers (cover:0,0,1;full;top, cover:1,0,1;full;top) providing shelf surfaces. check_build is ok and meshClash clear. The configurator only checks fit, not strength, and cannot verify or certify a 50 kg load rating — do not claim load ratings per system rules.

Two notch drawer frames installed: notch:0#0,1#notch1 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm-x2, double height) at 0,1,0 and notch:0#1,-1#notch4 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf-x2) at 1,-1,0. Each fills the empty position between the two adjacent bases and provides a drawer.

finish.summary: Built a 2-column, 2-storey shelf unit (4 bases with top covers) providing flat shelf surfaces, with two double-height notch drawer frames for drawers. Geometry passes all configurator checks (meshClash clear, no errors). Load rating to 50 kg cannot be verified by this configurator — it checks fit, not strength — so the rating requirement is unmet/partial by design; the build should be load-tested separately before use with heavy books.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Side connector, single
parts.use: Bridges the seam between two neighbouring cells and resists shear across it, for a cluster that gets pushed sideways rather than only loaded down.

parts.name: Side connector, double
parts.use: Bridges the seam between two neighbouring cells and resists shear across it, for a cluster that gets pushed sideways rather than only loaded down.

parts.name: Blank plug
parts.use: Fills an insert recess you are not using, so the face reads flat and the pocket stays clean.

parts.name: Female socket
parts.use: Seats in a recess and takes a stud, which makes it the bottom of every stacked insert.

parts.name: Male stud
parts.use: Threads through a seated socket and stands proud of the face, so it can carry whatever mounts above it.

parts.name: Foot
parts.use: Snaps onto a stud to give the face something to stand on, so a cell can rest on its cover rather than on its rim.

parts.name: Zip-tie anchor
parts.use: Seats in a recess and gives a cable tie something to pass through, so a bundle is anchored to the face instead of looped around it.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
